_about: Public-domain Michael Baumgarten (1812-1889), Lutheran theologian of Rostock, for the Word Hoard: The Acts of the Apostles, or The History of the Church in the Apostolic Age (3 vols, Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1854), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 48 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
